hypothesis: Explicit crop-image comparison recovers composition information missed by pooled candidate features.
data: RetargetVid/LIVE T5_CROPHEAD_V3 native crop, source-disjoint historical train/dev
pilot: one deterministically hashed row per dev source, both domains, no GT-conditioned sample selection
recall: R70 score peaks with minimum free-axis separation 1/8; center is included; candidate order is spatial rather than head rank

inference.precision: published FP32 weights with checkpoint BF16 autocast

selection: pilot diagnostics only; any adaptation uses TRAIN fit/tune sources, historical DEV final diagnostic
deployment: exact deterministic center85 temporal window, V9 candidate recall plus Valen spatial; no TimeLens2 outputs in deployable system
stop: candidate oracle inadequate: repair recall before SFT
